title: Term
description: One concept in a taxonomy (a category, a tag, a series). Content refers to terms by id, independent of locale; names, synonyms, archive intro and SEO are per locale. Renames, merges and retirements keep the id and leave redirects behind; `proposedBy` records the actor that proposed it (RFC-0002).

slug.description: URL segment of the term's archive; unique within its taxonomy, together with every slug in any term's slugHistory.

status.description: active: usable and public (subject to visibility). proposed: created by an agent, waiting for a person; assignable but never public. retired: no new assignments, no archive.

visibility.description: internal terms have no archive, feed or sitemap entry and are not shown on entries; themes and filters may still use them.

labels.description: Names per locale. Must contain the site's default locale.

parentId.description: Parent term in the same taxonomy; only in hierarchical taxonomies. No cycles.

position.description: Order among sibling terms (same taxonomy and parent), lowest first, for menus and sidebars. Terms without a position follow, by name.

links.description: Profile links shown with the term and given to search engines as sameAs, such as an author's pages elsewhere (RFC-0019 §1).

slugHistory.description: Earlier slugs, oldest first. Old slugs stay reserved in the taxonomy and still resolve when an agent assigns by slug.

mergedInto.description: Set when this term was merged into another active term of the same taxonomy; status is then 'retired'.

slug.description: This locale's archive slug (RFC-0033); absent uses the term's slug. Never set for the site's default locale, whose slug is the term's own; unique per taxonomy and locale.

altNames.description: Synonyms (SKOS altLabel). Matched when an agent or editor assigns by name; never shown as separate terms.

description.description: Markdown introduction shown at the top of the archive.

role.description: A short role or title shown with the term, such as an author's "Senior reporter" (RFC-0019 §1).
